status: Authored record contract; not an implemented companion schema migration
presenceRule: Preserve absent/null/empty/value separately in originalSource objects; derived fields explicitly state unresolved values

fields.fieldPresence: absent|null|value. value means a present non-null source value, including an empty string, array or object; do not normalize empty to absent or null.
fields.sourceSpelling: Conditional original JSON value: omit the key for absent; require literal null for null; require the exact original non-null value for value. Never substitute the canonical language ID or spelling.
fields.authority: exact grant/decision that permits the derived effect

constraints: If fieldPresence is absent, sourceSpelling MUST be absent.
If fieldPresence is null, sourceSpelling MUST be present with JSON null.
If fieldPresence is value, sourceSpelling MUST be present with the exact original non-null JSON value, including any empty value.
The sourcePath, sourceSha256, recordId and authority must identify the actual preserved source; a syntactically valid record alone does not authenticate that source.
Canonicalization belongs in derived identity fields and never rewrites this source value.

fields.canonicalLanguageId: explicit known ID; no fuzzy aliases
fields.modes: object: each of five defined modes is granted|not-granted|unspecified; unknown is never permission
fields.scripts: array of actual script/orthography ID plus provenance
fields.tenure: permanent or temporary linked to effect ID
fields.provenance: nonempty array of actual provenance records

constraints: A script-only grant cannot fabricate a speaking mode.
Physical channel suppression is recorded separately from competence.
Duplicate fixed grants union only genuinely granted modes and retain all sources.

fields.restriction: verbatim source restriction and derived eligibility rule
fields.alternatives: closed IDs if specified; otherwise null with actual available options recorded at resolution
fields.resolution: null while unresolved; otherwise selected ID/modes or exhausted result, actual eligibility evidence, time and retained original choice

constraints: Mycelian requires actual home-region evidence.
Elemental-Touched uses actual preselected affinity.
No secret future credit or free historical respec.

fields.source: exact card ID/path/hash and lawful access evidence
fields.consentEvidence: actual evidence when required; null only when source requires none
fields.expiration: original exact marker plus elapsed-time mapping through initiative changes

constraints: Not a second resource ledger.
Expiration removes capabilities, preserves only actually learned particular information.
No shared language implied unless this exact interface provides it.

fields.modules: required minutes, genuine prior same-script evidence, completed credit and remaining credit
fields.instruction: actual teacher modes plus usable channel OR identified authentic curriculum
fields.access: actual materials, legitimacy and production/correction method
fields.intervals: ordered start/end actual active intervals with complete phase credit, interruption reason and work-ledger references
fields.losses: actual source/effect, time and credited minutes lost; preserve history
fields.fees: actual quote, instruction minutes and invoice-rounded copper/payment record; no fabricated teacher
fields.completion: null or actual final practice, time and exact acquired modes

constraints: No overlapping work without explicit source permission, including tutor.
A phase boundary is not an actual concentration interruption.
A shorter final phase only finishes a real adjusted balance.

fields.underlyingEvidenceId: stable correspondence identity shared across copies and recreations
fields.languageAndScript: actual known identities, with unknown preserved
fields.passage: registered boundaries, words<=250 for bounded projects and explicit gaps
fields.sourceMeaningEvidence: finite supported meaning/key/evidence; unavailable explicitly fails prerequisite
fields.translationProvenance: actual method, lead, work, checks if required and output extent

constraints: A new physical copy does not create new evidence.
No caller boolean certifies missing meaning.
Copying characters alone is not translation or magical encoding.

fields.evidenceReceipts: all underlying correspondence IDs already studied by this reader, including saturated studies
fields.events: chronological actual gain/spend events, work references, evidence, amount, before/after, passage and prerequisite adjudication

constraints: A saturated award is not banked.
Copies/holders/editions/magical recreations share anti-repeat identity.
Three points and eight separate hours yield one supported passage, not fluency.

fields.contentEvidence: specific content/meaning available to sender, recipient language/mode evidence
fields.interpretation: zero or more incoming receipt -> interpretation -> outgoing delivery links
fields.receipts: actual recipients and arrival events with supported comprehension; no arbitrary understood flag
fields.roundBudget: numbered round plus aggregate free ordinary seconds, Actions/readied permission and no refresh on extra turns

constraints: No retroactive reception or reaction window.
Player explanations have no fictional communication event unless the character acts.
Hearing-only effects require actual hearing, not translated meaning by another channel.
